descriptionEn: Offered for sale: a house with 310m² of living area, with about 450m² of usable space in total, located in Lagjja Arbëria, in one of the most sought-after areas of Prishtina.
The property has a 4-are yard and parking for 2 cars.

The house is organised on several levels. The basement offers about 30m² of additional space. On the first floor there are the living room with kitchen, both with access to a large terrace, one bedroom, a storage room and a bathroom.
The second floor consists of three bedrooms, each with a balcony, as well as one bathroom. Two of the rooms offer panoramic views towards the city of Prishtina.
On the top floor there is a rooftop with an area of about 140m², with an open view over the city.
The property has an ownership certificate.
